role: Renders an EntityFallingBlock as its block: RenderBlocks.renderBlockSandFalling at the entity position (anvils and dragon eggs use their special renderers), skipped when the block below already matches.
scope_reason: Falling sand and gravel occur in gated recordings (world-falling-s1), so their pixels are in the compared frames' scope.

members.name: doRender
members.note: the sand path (renderBlockSandFalling), and the anvil and dragon egg through RenderBlocks (renderBlockAnvilMetadata with the entity's metadata, renderBlockDragonEgg) over the client world at the cell (rb_mesh_falling_block), each face's colour and brightness; drawn where WorldClient's copy is (pickobj.c's, lastTickPos to the position) and only while the client world's cell is not the block. idx-hudfx-s1 170 to 182 within 16 px; the landing frame 184 carries RenderGlobal's server-world mesh (the landed block a tick early)

notes: lane/entrender: raster_things.c draw_falling: renderBlockSandFalling's six faces with the 0.5/1/0.8/0.6 shades, lighting off, the block brightness at the entity's block. ent_falling: sand, gravel and red sand falling, 8 views within 4 px (master 13,758 to 14,796 px). lane/idxclient: the anvil and dragon egg variants drawn; the falling copies are the client's (pickobj.c), not the server's.
